Private interests include a wide range of external activities including financial and economic interests, family or private businesses, clubs or interest groups, and involvement in other employment.
  • Pecuniary interest – a pecuniary interest involves an actual or potential financial gain or loss.   • Non-pecuniary interest – a non-pecuniary interest does not have a financial component but may arise from personal or family relationships, involvement in sporting, social, trade union, community or cultural activities.
